subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Merit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Virtue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"merit"** means the quality of being particularly good or worthy, especially so as to deserve praise or reward. (योग्यता)

 
 
• **Example: **The merit of her work was recognized with a prestigious award.
 
 
 
• **"Virtue"** refers to behavior showing high moral standards; it is a synonym of merit as it denotes the quality of being morally good or righteous. (पुण्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Honesty is considered a virtue in many cultures.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Virtue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fatigue** (थकान): Extreme tiredness resulting from mental or physical exertion.

 
 
• **Example: **She was suffering from fatigue after the long journey.
 
 
 
• **Oblique** (तिरछा): Neither parallel nor at a right angle to a specified or implied line; slanting.
 
 
• **Example: **The oblique rays of the setting sun cast long shadows.
 
 
 
• **Residue** (अवशेष): A small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone or been taken or used.
 
 
• **Example: **There was a sticky residue left on the table after the spill.
